evidence.detail: metagame template only supports season-wide or tournament-only scope via data-season-id and data-tournament-only attributes; no person or competition scope
metagame controller has no person_id or competition_id parameters
Grid is hardcoded to endpoint /api/archetypes2/ accepting only seasonId and tournamentOnly — no per-person or per-competition filtering

triage.notes: Would require new or extended API endpoints for per-person and per-competition archetype stats, new URL routes, frontend controls to switch scope, and new or extended data queries. Well above the easy-fix threshold.
